annotations.title: Altitude and azimuth of every body from a place

description: Where the Sun, Moon and planets are in the sky from a place at a moment: altitude, azimuth, compass point, topocentric right ascension and declination, distance, elongation, illumination, magnitude and the sky state. E.g. {datetime: '2026-06-21T23:00', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. For sky maps, telescope pointing, AR and observation apps: each body's apparent altitude and azimuth (with refraction, or airless), whether it is above the horizon, its topocentric right ascension and declination, distance (and the Moon's in km), angular distance from the Sun, illuminated fraction and visual magnitude (planets), plus the sky state (day, civil / nautical / astronomical twilight, night). Matches NASA/JPL Horizons to under a second of arc. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/altaz (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

bodies.description: Bodies to locate. Default: all ten.

datetime.description: The moment: UTC ('2026-06-21T21:00:00Z'), with an explicit offset, or local civil time at the place ('2026-06-21T23:00', time zone resolved from the coordinates).

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

pressure_hpa.description: Air pressure for refraction, hPa, or 'standard' (from the elevation).

refraction.description: Apply atmospheric refraction to the altitude (true) or give the geometric, airless altitude (false).

temperature_c.description: Air temperature for refraction, deg C.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: altitude_azimuth

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

bodies.description: One row per body: altitude, azimuth, compass point, above_horizon, right_ascension_hours, declination, distance_au (and distance_km for the Moon), elongation from the Sun, illuminated_fraction and magnitude (planets).

settings.description: The bodies, whether refraction is applied (with temperature and pressure) and every convention.

sky.description: The Sun's altitude and the sky state: day, civil_twilight, nautical_twilight, astronomical_twilight or night.

subject.description: The place, its time zone, and the resolved moment ('time': local input, UTC, offset, Julian days, Delta T).
